info.title: Cadence API
info.description: Every answer is an envelope: `{ success: true, data }`, or `{ success: false, error: { code, message, details? } }`. Everything under `/api/v1` needs a Clerk session token.

get.summary: Report whether the API is up and the database is reachable.

200.description: The API is up and the database answers.

503.description: The database is unreachable. The body is the same report, with `status: "unhealthy"`, `database: "down"` and `success: false`.
